output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the mintedAmount parameter, which is added to the balanceOf mapping without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the _value parameter, which is added to the balanceOf mapping without a check, allowing the user to cause a denial of service (balance becomes frozen).

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the _value parameter, which is added to the balanceOf mapping without a check, allowing the user to cause a denial of service (balance becomes frozen).

The buy function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function allows users to buy tokens with ether, but the buyPrice is set by the owner, allowing the owner to manipulate the buyPrice to any value, causing financial loss to the users.

The sell function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function allows users to sell tokens for ether, but the sellPrice is set by the owner, allowing the owner to manipulate the sellPrice to any value, causing financial loss to the users.
